name: learning-objectives
description: Reward/constraint evaluation contract (W036, the W035 flat source-exported package pattern): the typed REWARD + CONSTRAINT evaluation vocabulary that W037 (trajectories/experiments) and W038 (evaluation/verification) build on. The §10 evidence capsule chain (observation → decision metadata → action → resulting state) as typed data over the W035 agent-world pass records; the reward model as a composition of typed components with the architecture law "Raw P&L is never the sole objective" (spec/ARCHITECTURE.md §13) enforced STRUCTURALLY at construction; hard/soft constraints as DATA, never prompt text (A13), with typed, ordered, evidence-linked violation records; the §13 evaluation-policy descriptor (holdout/stress/ablation/integrity axes) plus the deterministic reduction semantics (canonical order, explicit tie/overflow rules). A CONTRACT package: no RL algorithm, no training loop, no model calls. A9-deterministic and fail-closed at every seam.
